factory_install: Also look for model name as cros_payload entry If <model>.json in cros_payloads/ exists, use it as the cros_payload metadata. Otherwise fall back to use <board>.json. This opens a way to create an RMA shim that has different payloads for different models that belongs to the same board, without changing the RMA shim structure and image_tool. We can create RMA shims and set the model model name in `--board` argument, and merge them into a multi-board shim. A problem for this approach is that all kernels have the same signing key and bootable on the devices, so only the first kernel will be used, but it will not be a problem if all models are using identical factory shims.
